what.text: This page follows refugees from Chad living in Nigeria, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 69 Chadian refugees in Nigeria, 0.5% of all refugees from Chad.
The Central African Republic hosts the most Chadian refugees, followed by France, Cameroon and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Chad in periods from 1976 to 2023.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1980 and 1981, fall within the first period.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1980 at its highest figure, 100000 refugees.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Nigeria.
These are year-end totals for Nigeria only, reported to UNHCR.
